validation.current_legacy_hubs_source: verified 30 current CORE HOBBY_HUBs from Batches 001-003; Satellitenempfang excluded because it is not in current CORE

hubs.ownership: Airbrush owns generic technique, equipment, colors, maintenance and practice. Model-specific application intents belong to Airbrush-Modellbau; the Airbrush hub links to them instead of duplicating them.

Owns the end-to-end bean-to-bar process from cocoa raw material through roasting, refining, recipe development and finished bars. Generic chocolate/praline intents remain separate owners; bean-to-bar pages must keep explicit process context.

Owns aeroponics-specific systems, misting/nozzles, root chamber, aeroponic nutrient/water management and aeroponic plant operation. Generic hydroponics, hydroculture and indoor-growing intents stay with those identities.

article_intents: Low Pressure vs High Pressure Aeroponik

hubs.ownership: Owns ant husbandry, species, colony care, feeding, winter rest, climate and operational formicarium use. Construction-focused DIY intents belong to Formicarienbau; generic terrarium intents remain outside.

Owns 3D-parcours, 3D targets/scoring, terrain shooting, unknown-distance practice and equipment choices explicitly in 3D context. Generic archery basics/equipment belong to Bogenschießen; traditional-style intents belong to traditionelles Bogenschießen.

Owns Wabi-Kusa balls/containers, substrate, emersed aquatic-plant arrangements and their humidity/light/care. Aquascaping owns submerged aquarium layouts; Kokedama and Kusamono remain distinct plant practices.
Owns bookbinding craft, materials, tools and binding techniques. Course/provider/service intents belong to DIRECTORY and do not count as CORE article ownership.
Owns license-free CB-radio equipment, setup, antennas, operating practice and CB-specific communication. Amateur-radio licensing/modes remain with Amateurfunk.
Owns SDR hardware/software, receivers, decoding and SDR-specific projects. Specific radio services/communities keep their own operating intents.

Owns active radio communication via satellites, especially amateur-satellite operating practice. Receive-only satellite reception stays with Satellitenempfang; orbital tracking stays with Satellitentracking.
Owns receiving, tracking, predicting and recovering radiosondes/weather balloons. Generic SDR remains an enabling tool, not the primary owner.
Owns general radio-direction-finding equipment, bearings, triangulation and practical fox-hunt style exercises. Amateur Radio Direction Finding keeps the formal competitive-sport intent.
Owns platform-neutral microcontroller fundamentals, sensors/actuators, power, buses and embedded projects. Arduino-specific platform content stays with Arduino.
Owns Arduino boards, IDE/toolchain, libraries, shields and Arduino-specific projects. Generic embedded concepts remain with Mikrocontroller-Projekte.
Owns Raspberry-Pi-specific setup, Linux/GPIO, networking and maker projects. Generic microcontroller content stays separate.
Owns designing/building hobby robots, chassis, drives, sensors, controllers and integration. Application niches keep their own specific intents.

Owns generic hobby combat-robot building, drive/weapon systems, armor, safety and non-brand-specific competition preparation. The BattleBots name is reserved for official BattleBots events/shows/products and is not used as generic SEO owner.
Owns building/configuring drones as a maker practice. FPV-specific flying systems, racing and photography keep their own intents.
Owns general FPV-drone setup and flying. Competitive racing belongs to FPV-Racing; generic drone construction belongs to Drohnenbau.
Owns competitive FPV racing, race setup, track practice and race-specific tuning. Generic FPV operation stays with FPV-Drohnen.
Owns photographic image-making with drones. Generic drone operation/building stays with the drone identities; generic photography stays with Fotografie.
Owns technical crawling and off-road obstacle driving. Scale-focused realism stays with Scale-Crawling.
Owns radio-controlled construction machinery and functional model operation.
Owns radio-controlled truck building, scale outfitting and operation.
Owns radio-controlled tank models as functional model-building practice; historical subject matter is context, not a separate owner.
Owns sail-powered RC boats and sailing-specific setup/operation.
Owns radio-controlled submarines and their diving/sealing/control technology.
Owns generic powered RC-airplane basics and operation. Glider-specific intents stay with RC-Segelflug.
Owns sailplane-specific RC flight, thermals, slope soaring and glider setup.
Owns radio-controlled helicopters, helicopter-specific mechanics, setup and flight training.

Owns general painting learning, materials, colour handling, generic painting technique and composition. Context-specific identities such as Seidenmalerei, Glasmalerei, Miniaturen bemalen, Brandmalerei and Schildermalerei keep their specific intents.
Owns generic drawing basics, materials, line/form, perspective, value and general motif practice. Karten zeichnen and other context-specific identities keep their specific intents.

Owns generic sewing with machine/hand, fabrics, patterns, seams, fit and everyday projects. Historical clothing sewing, costume construction and other specialist identities keep their context-specific intents.
Owns generic knitting basics, yarn/needles, stitch patterns, shaping and ordinary knitting projects. Specialist textile identities retain their own techniques.
Owns generic crochet basics, yarn/hooks, stitch patterns, shaping and ordinary crochet projects. Specialist textile identities retain their specific intents.

Owns generic household DIY, mounting, repair and renovation practice. Specialist woodworking, metalwork, electrical/electronics, Smart Home and craft identities keep their technical/specialist intents.
Owns generic day/long-distance hiking basics, planning, equipment, walking technique and hiking safety. Specialist trekking/ultralight and other named outdoor identities keep their specific intents.
Owns generic recreational swimming, core techniques, training and general swim equipment. Specialist identities such as Freediving, Mermaid Swimming and Fin Swimming keep their specific intents.
Owns bouldering in hall and outdoors, movement technique, bouldering training and bouldering-specific equipment/safety. Generic climbing orientation remains with Klettern.

Owns generic home vegetable growing from planning and sowing through care and harvest. Crop-specific identities such as Chili-Zucht, Tomatensorten-Zucht and Saatguterhaltung keep their specific intents.

Owns generic philately/briefmark collection building, identification, cataloguing, condition, storage and exchange. Specialized postal-history or other paper-collecting identities keep their own intents.

Owns aircraft observation, identification, registrations, spotting locations, flight-tracking preparation and aircraft-specific photographic documentation. Generic camera/photography technique remains with Fotografie.
